headline: Brazilian Real Estate Fund Faces Second Tenant Judicial Recovery
summary: The Inter Logístico real estate investment fund reported that tenant Navarro Distribuidora de Medicamentos filed for judicial recovery, impacting space leased at the Log Gaiolli Business Park.
why: Real estate investment funds (FIIs) rely on tenant rental income for distributions, making tenant insolvencies a direct risk to fund yields.

impacts.name: Inter Logístico
impacts.why: A second tenant entering judicial recovery threatens rental revenue streams.
